# MakeMyCV.ae

> Free, ATS-clean CV builder designed for the UAE and GCC job market (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah). No sign-up, no paywall, no watermark. Data stays in the user's browser. Built for UAE-specific hiring: a dedicated "UAE Essentials" step covers visa status, nationality, driving licence, notice period and availability, and every template works with or without a photo (user's choice per application). Templates use the single-column, standard-section structure that ATS software parses reliably.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.makemycv.ae/): What MakeMyCV.ae is, who it's for, and why UAE CVs need ATS-clean formatting.
- [Templates](https://www.makemycv.ae/templates): All 10 free CV templates — ATS-friendly single-column layouts (Classic, ATS Clean, Professional) and design-led sidebar/two-column formats (Executive, Modern, Executive Split, Corporate, Onyx, Sandstone, Professional Photo). Every layout is available with or without a photo.
- [ATS Resume Checker](https://www.makemycv.ae/resume-checker): Free check of whether a CV passes the applicant tracking systems UAE employers use.
- [JD Match](https://www.makemycv.ae/jd-match): Paste a job description and see how closely a CV matches it, with the specific gaps to fix. The CV is compared in the browser.
- [UAE CV Examples](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae): Example CVs by role and industry, formatted for UAE hiring.
- [Build a CV (app)](https://app.makemycv.ae): The free builder tool — 10 steps, PDF and DOCX download, no account.

## Free tools
- [UAE Gratuity Calculator](https://www.makemycv.ae/gratuity-calculator): End-of-service gratuity under UAE Labour Law (resignation vs termination, service length).
- [Notice Period Calculator](https://www.makemycv.ae/notice-period-calculator): Notice period and last working day under UAE Labour Law.
- [Annual Leave Calculator](https://www.makemycv.ae/annual-leave-calculator): Accrued annual leave days and leave salary in the UAE.
- [Resignation Letter Generator](https://www.makemycv.ae/resignation-letter-generator): Generates a UAE-appropriate resignation letter with the correct notice wording.

- [Do UAE Companies Use ATS?](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/does-dubai-use-ats): Which Dubai and Abu Dhabi employers screen CVs with ATS software, and how to pass it.

- [MOHRE CV Format](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/mohre-cv-format-uae): What "MOHRE CV format" actually means in the UAE, and what MOHRE does and does not specify.

- [Dubai CV vs Abu Dhabi CV](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/dubai-cv-vs-abu-dhabi-cv): Formatting, tone and emphasis differences between the two markets.
- [Should Your CV Have a Photo in the UAE?](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/should-cv-have-photo-uae): The UAE photo convention vs Western rules, and ATS-safe placement.
- [Professional Summary Examples for UAE CVs](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/professional-summary-examples-uae-cv): Ready-to-use summary examples by industry.
